name: 1000 Wangzi : Sheng Er Wei Ai Ni
source:
A fracture in your timeline has caused all your prince husbands—spanning past, present and future from different settings—to time-travel to your current era. Now1,000 princes coexist on your shared timeline, protecting and adoring you.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3363000/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你们时间线的断裂导致你们所有的王子丈夫——来自不同背景的过去、现在和未来——穿越到你们当前的时代。现在，1,000位王子共存于你的共享时间线上，保护并崇拜你。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3363000/]Steam[/url]]
